text: Travel experiences can change our lives. When we plan a trip, we often feel excited and a little nervous. Visiting new cultures opens our minds and teaches us how other people live. Trying local food is one of the best parts of travelling, because every dish tells a story. Sometimes we face language barriers, but we can still communicate with smiles and gestures. These small challenges often become the funniest moments later. In the end, we return home with wonderful memories that stay with us forever.
